title: EGamersWorld shows the same 1.8 price on both sides of the two pick-less fixtures — it is a placeholder, not a market
detail: Read directly on 2026-10-21T20:37Z: https://egamersworld.com/counterstrike/match/rW6Ymkl0D/benched-gods-vs-titanflow-EcLgERbZn prints 1.8 for benched gods and 1.8 for TitanFlow, and https://egamersworld.com/counterstrike/match/4kaAQWgKEx/flyquest-vs-staqued-zawJ-Q52S3 prints 1.8 for FlyQuest and 1.8 for Staqued. A two-way book cannot price a ranked side against an unranked qualifier at even money, and no bookmaker is named on the widget. These prices are NOT used as inputs by this project and must not be read as a market-implied probability. They are published here only to document why the aggregated-reference rung keeps declining this fixture.

title: benched gods vs TitanFlow and FlyQuest vs Staqued now carry researched estimates, not bookmaker lines
detail: Both fixtures have a published directional pick as of the 2026-10-21T21:40Z build: benched gods 50.4% over TitanFlow (1081597) and FlyQuest 52.3% over Staqued (1082860). Both come from the HLTV world-ranking research rung: neither side has a money line and TitanFlow/Staqued have no HLTV ranking, so the estimate rests on partial ranking inputs and is labelled 'Researched'. This replaces the earlier 11be2015 finding that both fixtures had no pick at all, which was true of the 20:08Z snapshot but is no longer current. The picks are usable as a called side for pick'em purposes; they are not a claim that a bookmaker priced the match, and they must not be quoted as market-implied probabilities. EGamersWorld remains excluded for these two fixtures (see the symmetric 1.8/1.8 finding).

title: A cached read of the live site looked like the 15 Oct snapshot; the cache-busted read shows the current 21 Oct 20:08Z snapshot
detail: On 2026-10-21 the assistant's page reader returned https://buffedlizard55-lab.github.io/MaltaProj3/data/latest.json as generated_at 2026-10-15T08:36:13Z, which initially read as a stale deployment. Re-reading the same URL with a unique query string (?cb=7f3a91) returned generated_at 2026-10-21T20:08:24Z with inventory 76 / upcoming 13, exactly matching the production run's annotation for run 39666468012. The deployed site is current; the first read was a reader cache artifact. Recorded so that a later session does not 're-fix' a freshness problem that does not exist, and so that any future stale-site claim is cache-busted first. Unrelated, real limitation kept for the record: the repository's Pages site is a legacy build from the main branch root (HTTP 403 on any attempt to switch the build type), which is why scripts.publication has to publish the verified artifact itself.

title: First-hand check: the 13 published fixtures are exactly the 13 future-start fixtures in Hotspawn's own feed
detail: Read directly from https://phpstack-1372681-6459848.cloudwaysapps.com/api/v1/fixtures?sport_alias=cs2&status=scheduled&tenantId=1 at 2026-10-21T21:46Z, all eight response chunks parsed. Filtering status=scheduled with a start time still in the future leaves exactly 13 fixtures, and those 13 match the published page one-for-one: no fixture on the feed is missing from the site and the site lists no fixture the feed does not. The same payload also retains records whose start has already passed while still reporting 'scheduled' (for example 1081865 at 2026-10-21T03:00Z and 1079621 at 2026-10-14T08:00Z); those are excluded from the upcoming count by start time rather than deleted, which is why the site shows 13 and not the raw feed size. Record-level evidence: data/research/11be2015/live-coverage-verification-2026-10-21.json.

title: Zetta vs LOS NINOS: the 'wrong opponent' blocker is resolved by a five-player roster match
detail: Session arena-32bed9e3 flagged Polymarket cs2-ale1-ln-2026-10-21 and Kalshi KXCS2GAME-26OCT211800LNALE as a different match because the market title says 'Alianza Lima Esports' while Hotspawn/HLTV say 'Zetta'. Re-checked first-hand on 2026-10-21T21:46Z: HLTV match 2399865 prints Zetta's five as Notjuanjo, zockie, BabyRage, Antuanette and Slayerhz, which is the same five-player roster the Alianza Lima Esports registry row is built on; both markets name the same CCT South America Series 7 opponent (Los Niños / LOS NINOS) and the same 22:00Z start. The join is upheld and 1082837 is not a wrong-opponent case. It should no longer be read as a publishing blocker; the roster evidence is what carries it, not the organisation name. Residual risk kept on the record: if Alianza Lima Esports ever fields a different five in this competition, competition scope alone would stop being proof. Session arena-093e722e's separate warning is NOT withdrawn by this finding: it records that some mid-event Alianza Lima lineups list 1ayala instead of Antuanette, and that Strafe still lists both names as competitors. That substitution caveat remains open; what is settled is the fixture join (same match), not the standing of every roster source.

title: Two researched rows on the phone summary link the bo3.gg index, not a fixture page
detail: On the live 2026-10-21T23:04Z build, benched gods vs TitanFlow (1081597, 'TitanFlow 77.8% Researched') and Ground Zero vs Off Chops (1082858, 'Off Chops 55.5% Researched') both show the source chip 'bo3.gg results' pointing at https://bo3.gg/matches — the site index, not a match or series record for that fixture. Every other row points at a specific Hotspawn, Valve, Polymarket or HLTV URL. The pick itself is a researched model/line estimate, and the full evidence trail is on the fixture's origination card, but a reader following the summary chip lands on a search page and cannot verify the input directly. Change request for the origination owner: carry the per-fixture bo3.gg match URL (or the exact provider URL that backed the estimate) into the summary chip, or label the chip 'form model (index)' so it is not read as a fixture source. Also note the direction moved between refreshes for 1081597 (benched gods 50.4% at 22:08Z, TitanFlow 77.8% at 23:04Z) after the researched line replaced the ranking estimate; the later row states its own method on the origination card, and no value here should be read as a stable line.
